messages.subject: Fluid rows on tabset
parts:
Hello-

I have created a shiny app with multiple tabset panels, but cannot figure out if it's possible to display multiple output types on the same tab. For example, I have a summary tab that I would like to be output both a table and a graph for the item that they have selected from the dropdown menu. Is this possible? If so, could someone please tell me how! 

Thanks,
